items.text: RT by @NVIDIAAI: Inkling-small is out today! With SGLang, you can get 648 tok/s decode with DSpark (simulated acc len=4) and 288 tok/s w/o DSpark, under the same setup (8x @NVIDIAAI B200, TP 8, NVFP4, bs=1). What makes this model different is the size. 276B total with 12B active is a sweet spot for RL, and both LoRA and full-parameter training become well within reach. Miles is ready and verified for multimodal RL on Inkling-small, so you can turn your multimodal data into real capability gains. At ~1/4 the size, Inkling-small matches the bigger version in capability and even wins on some benchmarks. Run Inkling-small with SGLang, and customize it with Miles.
items.author: @lmsysorg

items.text: RT by @NVIDIAAI: 🎉 Congrats to @thinkymachines on Inkling-Small-- live with Day 0 vLLM support! 276B total parameters with 12B active, native text, image, and audio input, and a 1M-token context window. Open weights, built for agentic and tool-use systems, coding assistants, and RAG. Running on @NVIDIAAI accelerated infrastructure, vLLM optimizes Inkling-Small for Blackwell. The architecture mirrors Inkling, so it runs on the existing vLLM path! 1/2

items.text: RT by @danielnewmanUV: Structural AI demand is real and the 10+ trillion of AI capex that will be spent between now and 2030 will deliver companies like $NVDA and $MU remarkable earnings for the foreseeable future. We are at the point of the cycle where the trend and the demand can remain in tact but that has become completely irrelevant to how stocks behave. This is why we’ve seen indices go from ATH to year lows in less than 30 days. Great companies delivering great earnings can’t consistently overcome war, interest rates, inflation, policy, China, and other macro headwinds. The market is spooked, capital is nervous, and great companies are being sold. This won’t last forever. The same way everything can’t keep going up forever, the selling will slow, capitulation seems near. What a ride. 😐🙏🏻
